pages.text: Brews a cup of $(item)Coffee$() from a $(thing)water bucket$(), $(thing)3 grounds$() of the same roast and quality, and $(thing)furnace fuel$().
A cup takes 20 seconds. One coal brews 4 cups.

$(li)The coffee keeps the grounds' roast and quality.$(li)The empty bucket stays in the water slot: put in a new water bucket for each cup.$(li)A block of $(item)Ice$() instead brews $(l:caffeinecubed:drinks/ice_coffee)Ice Coffee$(/l), one block per cup.$(li)Hoppers: grounds in the top, water, ice and fuel in the sides, coffee out the bottom.

pages.title: Attachments
pages.text: Three attachments add slots to the machine's screen:$(li)$(l:caffeinecubed:coffee_machine/grinder_attachment)Grinder Attachment$(/l), on top$(li)$(l:caffeinecubed:coffee_machine/milk_frother)Milk Frother$(/l), on its right$(li)$(l:caffeinecubed:coffee_machine/syrup_compactor)Syrup Compactor$(/l), on its left$(br2)Left and right are as you face the machine's front.
